## Research question
What TypeScript static analysis, type-level safety, and compile-time protection mechanisms should an OpenAPI SDK wrapper use? Research the state of the art in 2025-2026 for: (1) Type-safe API client patterns - branded types, phantom types, tagged unions for API responses, template literal types for URL path construction, conditional types for auth-gated endpoints; (2) OpenAPI-to-TypeScript code generation best practices - openapi-typescript, openapi-fetch, zodios, fets, feTS, ts-rest, orval, hey-api; (3) Static analysis beyond ESLint - TypeScript compiler plugins, ts-morph for custom checks, API surface linting with api-extractor, knip for dead exports; (4) Zod and runtime validation integration with static types - zod inference, ensuring schema-type alignment at compile time; (5) Type-level testing approaches - tsd, expect-type, @type-challenges patterns; (6) Contract testing at the type level - ensuring SDK types match OpenAPI spec at build time; (7) Dependency injection and configuration type safety patterns; (8) Error handling type safety - discriminated unions, Result/Either patterns, typed error codes.
